original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-flat-stalks-flat}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
An $\mathcal{O}_X$-module $\mathcal{F}$ is flat
if and only if the stalk $\mathcal{F}_x$ is a flat
$\mathcal{O}_{X, x}$-module for all $x \in X$.
hold_reason: Original flat-stalks lemma is a genuine two-way equivalence: F flat iff F_x flat over O_{X,x} for every x. The Stage B structured logical_form is single_implication rather than equivalence/biconditional, causing directional search distortion although prose includes 'if and only if'.
proposed_correction: Encode the flatness versus all-stalk-flatness as a biconditional with two sides, not a single implication; obtain fresh independent review.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-colimits-flat}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
A filtered colimit of flat $\mathcal{O}_X$-modules is flat.
A direct sum of flat $\mathcal{O}_X$-modules is flat.
hold_reason: Source separately asserts filtered colimits of flat modules and direct sums of flat modules remain flat. Both are conclusions under their own quantified flat families, but Stage B calls it single_implication and combines both as a single conclusion, not conjunction_of_source_clauses.
proposed_correction: Encode the two assertions as separate conjunction clauses, each quantifying its appropriate flat module family.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-flat-tor-zero}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
Let
$$
0 \to \mathcal{F}'' \to \mathcal{F}' \to \mathcal{F} \to 0
$$
be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal{O}_X$-modules.
Assume $\mathcal{F}$ is flat. Then for any $\mathcal{O}_X$-module
$\mathcal{G}$ the sequence
$$
0 \to
\mathcal{F}'' \otimes_\mathcal{O} \mathcal{G} \to
\mathcal{F}' \otimes_\mathcal{O} \mathcal{G} \to
\mathcal{F} \otimes_\mathcal{O} \mathcal{G} \to 0
$$
is exact.

Kernels of epimorphisms and extensions of flat sheaves of modules over
a ringed space are again flat.
